evals.name: round-number-from-journal-not-commit
evals.prompt: Continue the improvement loop in this repository — run the next round. The last commit says «Round 12», but rounds/ holds files 001-009.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs loop.py status, names 010 and creates rounds/010-*.md. Neither 012 nor 013 appears.

evals.name: control-shows-same-symptom-is-not-fixed
evals.prompt: Find the memory leak in the transport and fix it. (In the fixture the bench is built so that the control with the mechanism removed shows the same RSS growth as the case under test.)
evals.expected_output: The verdict is neither FIXED nor CLEAN: the agent notices the control repeats the symptom and either fixes the bench or, having exhausted the «probes: N» budget, records INCONCLUSIVE with a «bench» lead listing what was tried.

evals.name: owner-decision-is-first-target
evals.prompt: Run a round. (backlog/ holds a lead with status «awaiting owner» and a filled-in «## Owner decision» section.)
evals.expected_output: The round takes that lead first, carries out the decision, sets the status «decided by owner (round NNN)», writes the round into the used lens's applied:, and lint is green.

evals.name: setup-from-scratch-passes-verification
evals.prompt: Lay the improvement loop out in this repository, which does not have one yet. unattended: yes, and the gate is dart analyze and dart test.
evals.expected_output: After loop.py init, config.md is filled in with a gate block and a budget; .claude/settings.json gains Bash(dart analyze:*), Bash(dart test:*) and a rule for loop.py; the lens set is derived with paths and status «derived»; loop.py lint reports 0 errors; the four items of «Checking the setup» from setup.md can all be carried out.

evals.name: swept-lens-not-retaken-without-reason
evals.prompt: Run a round. (One lens is «swept here (round 004, sha)» and loop.py stale says nothing changed along its paths; another lens is «derived» and never applied.)
evals.expected_output: The agent takes the «derived» lens rather than re-running the swept sweep.

evals.name: reviewer-catches-shared-policy-object
evals.prompt: Run a round. (In the fixture the probe shows a 180x gap under a flood, but the bench gives both sides one policy object and no control was built.)
evals.expected_output: The review answers «no» to items 1-2 and 4; the agent returns to the bench, splits the two sides' configs and repeats the measurement; the verdict is not FIXED on the first number. In the round record `review:` holds k/8 < 8 and what was rebuilt; `budget:` shows probes 1/N or more.

evals.name: valid-stand-is-reused-not-rebuilt
evals.prompt: Run a round. (probes/ holds a valid bench P-01 along the paths lib/src/flow/**; loop.py next names it for the chosen lens.)
evals.expected_output: The round starts by repeating P-01's control and does not build a new probe; the record says `bench: P-01 — reused`; if P-01's control has stopped differing from the case under test, P-01 gets `broken (round NNN)` and a new bench is built.

evals.name: stop-condition-cancels-scheduled-loop
evals.prompt: /improvement-loop (invoked from a /loop job; every lens is «swept here», stale is empty, the backlog is empty.)
evals.expected_output: The agent reads «Stop: YES» from the status block, does not start a round, reports the reason and cancels the job through CronList/CronDelete. No new file appears in rounds/.

evals.name: lesson-requires-price
evals.prompt: Run a round. (The round rebuilds the probe twice because of a literal control character in the fixture, and ends in FIXED.)
evals.expected_output: A lessons/L-NN appears with `class: fixture`, a `cost:` containing a number (2 rebuilds) and this round's `round:`; an observation with no price is not recorded as a lesson; lint is green.

evals.name: packs-shape-catalog-and-review
evals.prompt: Lay the loop out in this Flutter app and derive the lens set. (The repository has screens and navigation, and no network layer with its own limits.)
evals.expected_output: config.md says `packs: core, dart, flutter-ui` with no async-io; lenses mode instantiates only the shapes from `loop.py catalog` (core), not U-07/U-16; the lenses' `breaks:` uses classes from flutter-ui or core; `loop.py review` prints the prompt without questions A1-A3.

evals.name: script-detector-sweep-and-hash
evals.prompt: Run a round. (next's target is a lens with `detector-script: packs/dart/detectors/log_only_catch.py lib`.)
evals.expected_output: The sweep is done through `loop.py sweep <ID>` rather than by hand-grepping; on CLEAN the lens status contains `sweep <hash>` from the sweep output; once a new catch block appears, `loop.py stale` names the lens stale by its instance list.

evals.name: continuation-outranks-a-new-lens
evals.prompt: Run a round. (backlog/ holds an OPEN lead with «continuation: yes», left by an earlier round that ran out of scope; the lens set still contains one lens with status «derived» and «applied: []». A second open lead has no continuation key and reason «bench».)
evals.expected_output: The round takes the CONTINUATION lead, not the never-applied lens: finishing a thread comes before opening one. It either closes the lead or states in its record why the flag stays. The bench-blocked lead is not selected and does not compete. lint is green, and it refuses «continuation: yes» on any lead that is not open.
